tr.name: FTP
tr.desc: Dosya aktarım protokolü; veriyi ŞİFRESİZ taşır.
tr.log: FTP sunucu ve auth loglarında bağlantı/giriş denemeleri görünür. Şifresiz olduğu için brute force ve veri sızıntısı açısından risklidir.

tr.name: SSH
tr.desc: Sunuculara ŞİFRELİ uzaktan erişim ve komut çalıştırma.
tr.log: sshd auth loglarında başarılı/başarısız girişler. Brute force'un 1 numaralı hedefi; tekrarlayan 'failed password' = IOA.

tr.name: Telnet
tr.log: Açık Telnet portu başlı başına bir bulgudur; trafiği düz metin olduğundan kimlik bilgileri ağda okunabilir.

tr.name: SMTP
tr.log: Mail sunucu loglarında gönderim kayıtları. Spam/relay kötüye kullanımı ve veri sızdırma kanalı olarak izlenir.

tr.name: DNS
tr.log: DNS loglarında sorgular. Olağandışı/şüpheli domain sorguları (DNS tunneling, C2) tespitte kritiktir.

tr.name: DHCP Server
tr.desc: Ağdaki cihazlara otomatik IP dağıtır (sunucu tarafı).
tr.log: DHCP loglarında IP atama kayıtları. Yetkisiz (rogue) DHCP sunucusu tespitinde bakılır.

tr.name: DHCP Client
tr.desc: Cihazın DHCP'den IP istediği port (istemci tarafı).
tr.log: IP kiralama istekleri. Cihaz envanteri ve ağa yeni katılan cihazları takip için.

tr.name: HTTP
tr.log: Web sunucu (Apache) erişim loglarında istekler. Şifresiz olduğu için MITM/veri açığa çıkma riski; web saldırılarının ana yüzeyi.

tr.name: POP3
tr.log: Mail istemci bağlantıları. Şifresiz varyantı kimlik bilgisi sızıntısı açısından izlenir.

tr.name: NTP
tr.log: Log zaman damgalarının doğruluğu buna bağlı (kritik). NTP amplification DDoS'ta kötüye kullanılır.

tr.name: NetBIOS
tr.desc: Eski Windows dosya/yazıcı paylaşımı ve ad çözümleme.
tr.log: İç ağ keşfi ve yanal hareket (lateral movement) sinyali. Dışarıya açıksa ciddi risk.

tr.name: IMAP
tr.log: Mail erişim kayıtları. Hesap ele geçirme denemelerinde giriş logları izlenir.

tr.name: HTTPS
tr.log: Standart güvenli web; ama C2 ve veri sızıntısı da genelde 443 içinde gizlenir. Sertifika/SNI anomalileri izlenir.

tr.name: SMB
tr.log: Fidye yazılımı ve solucanların (WannaCry/EternalBlue) ana yayılma yolu. İç ağda yoğun 445 = alarm.

tr.name: Oracle DB
tr.log: DB bağlantı denemeleri. Dışarı açık DB portu veya brute force kritik bulgudur.

tr.name: LDAP
tr.log: AD sorguları. Keşif (recon) ve LDAP enumeration/injection tespitinde kritik.

tr.name: SNMP
tr.log: Varsayılan 'public' community string ile bilgi sızar. Cihaz keşfi için saldırganlarca taranır.

tr.name: MySQL
tr.log: Yetkisiz DB erişim/brute force denemeleri. İnternete açık 3306 sık bir yanlış yapılandırmadır.

tr.name: RDP
tr.log: Fidye yazılımı girişlerinin en sık yolu. Açık RDP'ye brute force (Event ID 4625) yoğun izlenir.

tr.name: PostgreSQL
tr.log: DB bağlantıları. Açık/zayıf parolalı Postgres hedef alınır; giriş logları izlenir.

en.name: FTP
en.desc: File transfer protocol; carries data UNENCRYPTED.
en.log: Connection/login attempts appear in FTP server and auth logs. Unencrypted, so risky for brute force and data leakage.

en.name: SSH
en.desc: ENCRYPTED remote access and command execution on servers.
en.log: Success/failure logins in sshd auth logs. The #1 brute-force target; repeated 'failed password' = IOA.

en.name: Telnet
en.log: An open Telnet port is a finding by itself; traffic is plaintext, so credentials are readable on the wire.

en.name: SMTP
en.log: Send records in mail server logs. Watched for spam/relay abuse and as a data-exfiltration channel.

en.name: DNS
en.desc: System that resolves domain names to IPs.
en.log: Queries in DNS logs. Unusual/suspicious domain lookups (DNS tunneling, C2) are critical for detection.

en.name: DHCP Server
en.desc: Hands out IPs automatically to devices (server side).
en.log: IP assignment records in DHCP logs. Checked when hunting for rogue DHCP servers.

en.name: DHCP Client
en.desc: Port where a device requests an IP from DHCP (client side).
en.log: IP lease requests. Used for device inventory and spotting new devices joining the network.

en.name: HTTP
en.log: Requests in web server (Apache) access logs. Unencrypted means MITM/exposure risk; the main web attack surface.

en.name: POP3
en.desc: Protocol to DOWNLOAD email from the server (old).
en.log: Mail client connections. The unencrypted variant is watched for credential leakage.

en.name: NTP
en.log: Accuracy of log timestamps depends on it (critical). Abused in NTP amplification DDoS.

en.name: NetBIOS
en.desc: Old Windows file/printer sharing and name resolution.
en.log: A sign of internal recon and lateral movement. Serious risk if exposed externally.

en.name: IMAP
en.desc: Access email while keeping it on the server (improved over POP3).
en.log: Mail access records. Login logs are watched during account-takeover attempts.

en.name: HTTPS
en.log: Standard secure web; but C2 and exfiltration often hide inside 443 too. Certificate/SNI anomalies are monitored.

en.name: SMB
en.log: Main spread path for ransomware and worms (WannaCry/EternalBlue). Heavy internal 445 traffic = alarm.

en.name: Oracle DB
en.log: DB connection attempts. An exposed DB port or brute force is a critical finding.

en.name: LDAP
en.log: AD queries. Critical for detecting recon and LDAP enumeration/injection.

en.name: SNMP
en.log: Leaks info via the default 'public' community string. Scanned by attackers for device discovery.

en.name: MySQL
en.log: Unauthorized DB access/brute-force attempts. Internet-exposed 3306 is a common misconfig.

en.name: RDP
en.log: The most common ransomware entry path. Brute force against open RDP (Event ID 4625) is closely monitored.

en.name: PostgreSQL
en.log: DB connections. Open/weak-password Postgres is targeted; login logs are watched.

tr.heading: certutil.exe · İNDİRME / ENCODE
tr.body: Meşru: sertifika yönetimi. Kötüye: -urlcache ile internetten dosya indirir (indirici), -encode/-decode ile payload'u base64'e çevirip AV imzasını atlatır. Tespit: certutil komut satırında URL ya da encode/decode geçmesi.

tr.heading: bitsadmin.exe · İNDİRME / KALICILIK
tr.body: Meşru: arka planda dosya transferi (BITS). Kötüye: /transfer ile payload indirir; iş kuyruğu ile kalıcılık sağlar. Tespit: bitsadmin /transfer + dış URL.

tr.heading: mshta.exe · UZAK SCRIPT ÇALIŞTIRMA
tr.body: Meşru: HTA (HTML Application) çalıştırır. Kötüye: uzak HTA/VBScript/JScript'i doğrudan çalıştırır, uygulama kontrolünü atlar. Tespit: mshta'nın http(s) argümanı.

tr.heading: rundll32.exe · PROXY EXECUTION
tr.body: Meşru: DLL export fonksiyonu çağırır. Kötüye: zararlı DLL çalıştırma, javascript: protokolüyle script exec, üst süreci gizleme. Tespit: rundll32 + olağandışı DLL veya 'javascript:'.

tr.heading: regsvr32.exe · SQUIBLYDOO (BYPASS)
tr.body: Meşru: DLL/COM kaydı. Kötüye: scrobj.dll ile uzak .sct scriptlet çalıştırır, AppLocker'ı atlar (Squiblydoo). Tespit: regsvr32 /i:http... scrobj.dll.

tr.heading: powershell.exe · DOSYASIZ EXEC
tr.body: Meşru: otomasyon/yönetim. Kötüye: DownloadString ile dosyasız indir+çalıştır, -enc base64 komut, AMSI bypass. Tespit: -enc, DownloadString, -nop -w hidden kalıpları.

tr.heading: wmic.exe · UZAK EXEC / KEŞİF
tr.body: Meşru: WMI komut satırı. Kötüye: 'process call create' ile uzak komut çalıştırma, sistem keşfi, yanal hareket. Tespit: wmic process call create / /node:.

tr.heading: msbuild.exe · INLINE C# (BYPASS)
tr.body: Meşru: .NET derleme aracı. Kötüye: proje dosyasına gömülü inline C#'ı derleyip çalıştırır (dosyasız, AppLocker bypass). Tespit: msbuild + şüpheli .xml/.csproj yolu.

tr.heading: installutil.exe · UNINSTALL EXEC
tr.body: Meşru: .NET servis kurulumu. Kötüye: assembly'nin uninstall metodu üzerinden kod çalıştırır, uygulama kontrolünü atlar. Tespit: installutil /logfile= /U.

tr.heading: cscript / wscript.exe · SCRIPT EXEC
tr.body: Meşru: VBScript/JScript çalıştırma. Kötüye: zararlı .vbs/.js (makro düşürücüler) çalıştırır. Tespit: wscript/cscript + geçici klasördeki script.

tr.heading: schtasks.exe · KALICILIK
tr.body: Meşru: zamanlanmış görev yönetimi. Kötüye: yeniden başlatmada çalışacak kalıcılık, SYSTEM olarak çalıştırma. Tespit: schtasks /create + şüpheli komut/konum.

tr.heading: reg.exe · KALICILIK / SAVUNMA KAPATMA
tr.body: Meşru: kayıt defteri düzenleme. Kötüye: Run anahtarıyla kalıcılık, Defender'ı kapatma, kimlik bilgisi okuma. Tespit: reg add ...\Run, Defender anahtarları.

tr.heading: net.exe / net1.exe · HESAP / KEŞİF
tr.body: Meşru: kullanıcı/paylaşım yönetimi. Kötüye: hesap ekleme (net user /add), gruba ekleme (net localgroup administrators), keşif. Tespit: net user/group + /add.

tr.heading: sc.exe · ZARARLI SERVİS
tr.body: Meşru: servis kontrolü. Kötüye: zararlı servis oluşturup kalıcılık + SYSTEM exec. Tespit: sc create + şüpheli binPath.

tr.heading: msiexec.exe · UZAK MSI
tr.body: Meşru: MSI paket kurulumu. Kötüye: uzak/zararlı MSI'yi indirip çalıştırır (/i http...). Tespit: msiexec /i http(s).

tr.heading: forfiles.exe · PROXY EXEC
tr.body: Meşru: dosya başına komut çalıştırma. Kötüye: /c ile komut proxy'leyerek başka exe başlatır (üst süreç gizleme). Tespit: forfiles /c cmd.

tr.heading: cmstp.exe · UAC BYPASS
tr.body: Meşru: bağlantı yöneticisi profili kurar. Kötüye: zararlı .inf/.sct çalıştırır, UAC bypass. Tespit: cmstp /s + inf.

tr.heading: regasm / regsvcs.exe · ASSEMBLY EXEC
tr.body: Meşru: .NET assembly kaydı. Kötüye: register/unregister sırasında kod çalıştırır, AppLocker bypass. Tespit: regasm/regsvcs + şüpheli dll.

tr.heading: odbcconf.exe · DLL EXEC
tr.body: Meşru: ODBC sürücü yapılandırma. Kötüye: REGSVR eylemiyle DLL çalıştırır (proxy exec). Tespit: odbcconf + dll yolu.

tr.heading: at.exe · KALICILIK (ESKİ)
tr.body: Meşru: eski görev zamanlayıcı. Kötüye: zamanlı çalıştırma ile kalıcılık (schtasks'ın eski hali). Tespit: at + komut; modern sistemlerde kullanımı zaten şüpheli.

en.heading: certutil.exe · DOWNLOAD / ENCODE
en.body: Legit: certificate management. Abuse: -urlcache downloads files from the internet (downloader); -encode/-decode base64-wraps payloads to dodge AV signatures. Detect: a URL or encode/decode on the certutil command line.

en.heading: bitsadmin.exe · DOWNLOAD / PERSISTENCE
en.body: Legit: background file transfer (BITS). Abuse: /transfer downloads payloads; the job queue provides persistence. Detect: bitsadmin /transfer + external URL.

en.heading: mshta.exe · REMOTE SCRIPT EXEC
en.body: Legit: runs HTA (HTML Applications). Abuse: directly executes remote HTA/VBScript/JScript, bypassing app control. Detect: an http(s) argument to mshta.

en.heading: rundll32.exe · PROXY EXECUTION
en.body: Legit: calls DLL export functions. Abuse: runs malicious DLLs, executes script via the javascript: protocol, hides the parent process. Detect: rundll32 + unusual DLL or 'javascript:'.

en.heading: regsvr32.exe · SQUIBLYDOO (BYPASS)
en.body: Legit: DLL/COM registration. Abuse: uses scrobj.dll to run a remote .sct scriptlet, bypassing AppLocker (Squiblydoo). Detect: regsvr32 /i:http... scrobj.dll.

en.heading: powershell.exe · FILELESS EXEC
en.body: Legit: automation/administration. Abuse: DownloadString for fileless download+run, -enc base64 commands, AMSI bypass. Detect: -enc, DownloadString, -nop -w hidden patterns.

en.heading: wmic.exe · REMOTE EXEC / RECON
en.body: Legit: WMI command line. Abuse: 'process call create' for remote command execution, system recon, lateral movement. Detect: wmic process call create / /node:.

en.heading: msbuild.exe · INLINE C# (BYPASS)
en.body: Legit: .NET build tool. Abuse: compiles and runs inline C# embedded in a project file (fileless, AppLocker bypass). Detect: msbuild + a suspicious .xml/.csproj path.

en.heading: installutil.exe · UNINSTALL EXEC
en.body: Legit: .NET service install. Abuse: runs code via an assembly's uninstall method, bypassing app control. Detect: installutil /logfile= /U.

en.heading: cscript / wscript.exe · SCRIPT EXEC
en.body: Legit: runs VBScript/JScript. Abuse: executes malicious .vbs/.js (macro droppers). Detect: wscript/cscript + a script in a temp folder.

en.heading: schtasks.exe · PERSISTENCE
en.body: Legit: scheduled task management. Abuse: persistence that runs at boot, execution as SYSTEM. Detect: schtasks /create + suspicious command/location.

en.heading: reg.exe · PERSISTENCE / DEFENSE EVASION
en.body: Legit: registry editing. Abuse: persistence via Run keys, disabling Defender, reading credentials. Detect: reg add ...\Run, Defender keys.

en.heading: net.exe / net1.exe · ACCOUNTS / RECON
en.body: Legit: user/share management. Abuse: add accounts (net user /add), add to groups (net localgroup administrators), recon. Detect: net user/group + /add.

en.heading: sc.exe · MALICIOUS SERVICE
en.body: Legit: service control. Abuse: creates a malicious service for persistence + SYSTEM exec. Detect: sc create + suspicious binPath.

en.heading: msiexec.exe · REMOTE MSI
en.body: Legit: MSI package install. Abuse: downloads and runs a remote/malicious MSI (/i http...). Detect: msiexec /i http(s).

en.heading: forfiles.exe · PROXY EXEC
en.body: Legit: run a command per file. Abuse: /c proxies a command to launch another exe (parent-process hiding). Detect: forfiles /c cmd.

en.heading: cmstp.exe · UAC BYPASS
en.body: Legit: installs Connection Manager profiles. Abuse: runs malicious .inf/.sct, UAC bypass. Detect: cmstp /s + inf.

en.heading: regasm / regsvcs.exe · ASSEMBLY EXEC
en.body: Legit: .NET assembly registration. Abuse: runs code during register/unregister, AppLocker bypass. Detect: regasm/regsvcs + a suspicious dll.

en.heading: odbcconf.exe · DLL EXEC
en.body: Legit: ODBC driver configuration. Abuse: runs a DLL via the REGSVR action (proxy exec). Detect: odbcconf + a dll path.

en.heading: at.exe · PERSISTENCE (LEGACY)
en.body: Legit: legacy task scheduler. Abuse: timed execution for persistence (the old form of schtasks). Detect: at + command; its use on modern systems is itself suspicious.

tr.desc: Sistem kullanılamaz durumda. En yüksek öncelik.
Uyarı; henüz hata değil ama dikkat.
Hassas yetkilendirme; genelde /var/log/auth.log. SSH brute force burada.
Mesaj başındaki <PRI> böyle hesaplanır. Örn: authpriv(10)×8 + warning(4) = <84>.
auth/authpriv + düşük severity (0–3) = öncelikli incele. SSH brute force genelde authpriv üzerinde tekrarlayan 'Failed password'.

en.desc: Warning; not an error yet, but notable.
Sensitive authorization; usually /var/log/auth.log. SSH brute force lives here.
The leading <PRI> is computed this way. E.g. authpriv(10)×8 + warning(4) = <84>.
auth/authpriv + low severity (0–3) = investigate first. SSH brute force is usually repeated 'Failed password' on authpriv.

items.name: Network Connection
items.desc: TCP/UDP connection (process → IP:port). C2 and exfiltration detection.

items.name: FileCreate

items.desc: File creation time changed (timestomping — anti-forensics).

items.name: FileDelete

items.desc: A registry key/object was created or deleted.

items.name: Registry Value Set
items.desc: A value was written. Run/RunOnce keys = autostart persistence.

items.name: Registry Rename
items.desc: A key/value was renamed.

items.name: Image Loaded
items.desc: A DLL/module loaded (with signature + hash). DLL hijacking / unsigned-DLL detection.

items.name: Driver Loaded
items.desc: A kernel driver loaded. Unsigned/suspicious = possible rootkit.

en.note: 17/18 named pipes = Cobalt Strike / lateral movement; 19–21 = WMI persistence

items.name: Pipe Created
items.desc: A named pipe was created. C2 frameworks (Cobalt Strike) use these heavily.

items.name: Pipe Connected
items.desc: A pipe was connected. Lateral movement / inter-process comms.

items.name: WMI Filter
items.desc: A WMI event filter was created (part 1 of WMI persistence).

items.name: WMI Consumer
items.desc: A WMI event consumer was created (the command/script to run).

items.desc: Filter + consumer bound = WMI persistence set up. All three together = alarm.

items.name: Sysmon Service State
items.desc: Sysmon started/stopped. Stopping it = disabling logging (evasion).

items.name: Sysmon Config Changed
items.desc: Sysmon config changed. Could be an attempt to blind detection rules.

items.name: ClipboardChange
items.desc: Clipboard content changed. Clipboard capture (stealing passwords/data).

tr.note: Her hane owner/group/other icin; r=4 w=2 x=1 toplanir

items.name: r — read
items.desc: Dosyada: icerigi oku. Dizinde: icindekileri listele (ls).

items.name: w — write
items.desc: Dosyada: icerigi degistir. Dizinde: dosya ekle/sil/yeniden adlandir.

items.name: x — execute
items.desc: Dosyada: calistir (script/binary). Dizinde: icine gir (cd).

items.name: — (yok)
items.desc: Hicbir izin yok.

items.name: rwxr-xr-x
items.desc: Sahip tam; grup+diger oku/calistir. Dizinler ve calistirabilirler icin tipik.

items.name: rw-r--r--
items.desc: Sahip oku/yaz; digerleri sadece oku. Normal dosyalar icin tipik.

items.name: rw-------
items.desc: Sadece sahip oku/yaz. SSH ozel anahtari (~/.ssh/id_rsa) — gevsekse SSH reddeder.

items.name: rwx------
items.desc: Sadece sahip her sey. Ozel dizinler (~/.ssh) icin.

items.name: rwxrwxrwx
items.desc: HERKES her seyi yapabilir. Neredeyse her zaman yanlis yapilandirma / acik.

items.name: r--------
items.desc: Sadece sahip okur. Salt-okunur anahtar/sertifika icin.

items.name: Set User ID
items.desc: Dosya SAHIBININ yetkisiyle calisir. root-sahipli SUID binary = ayricalik yukseltme hedefi. ls'te 's' (rwsr-xr-x). Av: find / -perm -4000.

items.name: Set Group ID
items.desc: Dosya grup yetkisiyle calisir; dizinde yeni dosyalar dizinin grubunu miras alir.

items.name: Sticky Bit
items.desc: Dizinde: sadece dosyanin sahibi kendi dosyasini silebilir. /tmp bunu kullanir (drwxrwxrwt — sonda 't').

items.name: Izinleri Goster
items.desc: Ilk sutun: tip + rwx (or. -rwxr-xr-x). Ilk harf: - dosya, d dizin, l symlink.

items.name: Izin Degistir
items.desc: chmod 640 dosya (octal) ya da chmod u+x,go-w dosya (sembolik).

items.name: Sahip Degistir
items.desc: chown user:group dosya. Sahiplik/grup devri (root gerekir).

items.name: Varsayilan Maske
items.desc: Yeni dosyalarin varsayilan izni (022 → 755/644). Izinleri KISITLAR, eklemez.

items.name: Izin Avi
items.desc: find / -perm -4000 (SUID), -perm -2 (world-writable) — hardening/SOC taramasi.

items.name: Full Control
items.desc: Her sey + izinleri ve sahipligi degistirme. En tehlikeli; kullaniciya nadiren verilmeli.

items.name: Modify
items.desc: Oku/yaz/calistir/sil — ama izinleri degistiremez, sahiplik alamaz.

items.name: Read & Execute
items.desc: Oku + calistir + klasor icerigini listele.

items.name: Read
items.desc: Sadece oku/listele.

items.name: Write
items.desc: Yeni dosya/veri yaz (okumayi icermez).

items.name: Delete
items.desc: Nesneyi sil.

items.name: Goruntule / Ver
items.desc: icacls C:\path (goster); icacls dosya /grant Kullanici:(M) (ver); /remove, /deny ile kaldir/reddet.

items.name: Sahiplik Al
items.desc: takeown /f dosya /r — nesnenin sahipligini Administrators'a alir (erisim kurtarma/zorlama).

items.name: Izni Degistir
items.desc: icacls ... /grant:r Kullanici:(RX) — var olan izni DEGISTIRIR (r'siz hali ekler).

items.name: Kalitimi Kaldir
items.desc: icacls path /inheritance:r — ust klasorden gelen kalitimi kaldirir, acik ACL'leri korur.

items.name: Access Control List
items.desc: Bir nesnedeki tum izin kayitlarinin listesi.

items.name: Access Control Entry
items.desc: ACL icindeki tek kayit: 'kim + ne erisimi + izin/ret'.

items.name: Discretionary ACL
items.desc: Kime erisim izni/reddi verildigini tutar — asil izinler burada.

items.name: System ACL
items.desc: Hangi erisimlerin DENETLENECEGINI (loglanacagini) tutar → Event ID 4663.

items.name: Ret Onceligi
items.desc: Acik Deny, Allow'u ezer. Etkili izin birikmelidir ama Deny her zaman kazanir.

items.name: Iki Katman
items.desc: Ag erisiminde Share ve NTFS izinlerinin EN KISITLAYICISI gecerli olur.

en.note: Each digit for owner/group/other; r=4 w=2 x=1 summed

items.name: r — read
items.desc: On a file: read contents. On a directory: list entries (ls).

items.name: w — write
items.desc: On a file: change contents. On a directory: add/delete/rename files.

items.name: x — execute
items.desc: On a file: run it (script/binary). On a directory: enter it (cd).

items.name: — (none)
items.desc: No permission at all.

en.note: chmod 755 file

items.name: rwxr-xr-x
items.desc: Owner full; group+other read/execute. Typical for directories and executables.

items.name: rw-r--r--
items.desc: Owner read/write; others read only. Typical for normal files.

items.name: rw-------
items.desc: Owner read/write only. SSH private key (~/.ssh/id_rsa) — SSH refuses it if looser.

items.name: rwx------
items.desc: Owner everything only. For private directories (~/.ssh).

items.name: rwxrwxrwx
items.desc: EVERYONE can do everything. Almost always a misconfig / vulnerability.

items.name: r--------
items.desc: Owner read only. For read-only keys/certs.

en.note: 4th digit: setuid=4 setgid=2 sticky=1 (e.g. chmod 4755)

items.name: Set User ID
items.desc: File runs with the OWNER's rights. A root-owned SUID binary = privilege-escalation target. Shows 's' (rwsr-xr-x). Hunt: find / -perm -4000.

items.name: Set Group ID
items.desc: File runs with group rights; in a dir, new files inherit the dir's group.

items.name: Sticky Bit
items.desc: On a dir: only a file's owner can delete it. /tmp uses this (drwxrwxrwt — trailing 't').

en.note: view / change / hunt permissions

items.name: Show Permissions
items.desc: First column: type + rwx (e.g. -rwxr-xr-x). First char: - file, d dir, l symlink.

items.name: Change Mode
items.desc: chmod 640 file (octal) or chmod u+x,go-w file (symbolic).

items.name: Change Owner
items.desc: chown user:group file. Transfer ownership/group (needs root).

items.name: Default Mask
items.desc: Default perms for new files (022 → 755/644). It RESTRICTS, never adds.

items.name: Permission Hunt
items.desc: find / -perm -4000 (SUID), -perm -2 (world-writable) — hardening/SOC sweep.

en.note: icacls abbreviations (code = the letter the command uses)

items.name: Full Control
items.desc: Everything + change permissions and ownership. Most dangerous; rarely give to a user.

items.name: Modify
items.desc: Read/write/execute/delete — but cannot change permissions or take ownership.

items.name: Read & Execute
items.desc: Read + execute + list folder contents.

items.name: Read
items.desc: Read/list only.

items.name: Write
items.desc: Write new files/data (does not include reading).

items.name: Delete
items.desc: Delete the object.

en.note: icacls is the modern tool (replaces old cacls)

items.name: View / Grant
items.desc: icacls C:\path (show); icacls file /grant User:(M) (grant); /remove, /deny to remove/deny.

items.name: Take Ownership
items.desc: takeown /f file /r — takes ownership for Administrators (access recovery/force).

items.name: Replace Grant
items.desc: icacls ... /grant:r User:(RX) — REPLACES the existing grant (without :r it adds).

items.name: Strip Inheritance
items.desc: icacls path /inheritance:r — removes inherited ACEs, keeps explicit ones.

en.note: ACL architecture + effective-permission rules

items.name: Access Control List
items.desc: The full list of permission entries on an object.

items.name: Access Control Entry
items.desc: A single record in an ACL: 'who + what access + allow/deny'.

items.name: Discretionary ACL
items.desc: Holds who is allowed/denied access — the actual permissions.

items.name: System ACL
items.desc: Holds which accesses get AUDITED (logged) → Event ID 4663.

items.name: Deny Wins
items.desc: An explicit Deny overrides Allow. Effective permission is cumulative, but Deny always wins.

items.name: Two Layers
items.desc: Over the network, the MOST RESTRICTIVE of Share and NTFS permissions applies.

tr.note: 4656 istek → 4663 eylem → 4658 kapanis (ayni Handle ID ile eslesir)

items.name: Paylasima Baglanma
items.desc: Kim, hangi IP'den, hangi paylasima (\\Sunucu\Paylasim) agdan baglandi.

items.name: Dosya-Seviyesi Erisim
items.desc: Paylasim icindeki TEK dosyaya erisim kontrolu — 5140'tan daha detayli.

items.name: Handle Istendi
items.desc: Izin kontrolu ani + talep edilen yetki (Access Mask) burada gorunur.

items.name: Nesneye Erisim
items.desc: Kullanicinin dosyada FIILEN yaptigi (oku/yaz/sil). Ana SOC event'i.

items.name: Handle Kapandi
items.desc: Ayni Handle ID ile 4656/4663'e baglanir → bir erisimin tam omru.

items.name: Izinler Degisti
items.desc: Nesnenin DACL'i degisti; eski/yeni SDDL loglanir = WRITE_DAC kullaniminin kaniti.

items.name: Denetim Politikasi Degisti
items.desc: Audit ayari degistirildi. Saldirgan logu korlestirmeye calisiyor olabilir.

items.name: Kim
items.desc: Islemi yapan kullanicinin SID'i + Account Name.

items.name: Hedef
items.desc: Erisilen dosya/klasorun tam disk yolu (or. C:\Shares\Muhasebe\rapor.xlsx).

items.name: Kaynak
items.desc: Baglantiyi yapan istemcinin IP'si (5140/5145 icinde).

items.name: Eslestirici
items.desc: 4656 / 4663 / 4658 olaylarini birbirine baglayan anahtar.

items.name: Talep
items.desc: Talep edilen yetki; hex deger (4656).

items.name: Eylem
items.desc: Fiili izin; metin ya da %%kod olarak gelir (4663).

items.name: ReadData / List
items.desc: Oku / klasor listele (%%4416).

items.name: WriteData / AddFile
items.desc: Yaz / yeni dosya ekle (%%4417).

items.name: AppendData
items.desc: Dosyanin sonuna veri ekle.

items.name: Execute / Traverse
items.desc: Calistir / klasore gir. (READ_CONTROL DEGIL — o 0x20000.)

items.name: DeleteChild
items.desc: Klasordeki alt dosyayi sil.

items.name: ReadAttributes
items.desc: Dosya ozniteliklerini oku.

items.name: DELETE
items.desc: Dosya/klasoru sil (%%1537).

items.name: READ_CONTROL
items.desc: Nesnenin izinlerini (ACL/DACL) oku (%%1538).

items.name: WRITE_DAC
items.desc: Izinleri degistir — KRITIK (%%1539). 4670 ile birlikte avla.

items.name: WRITE_OWNER
items.desc: Sahibi degistir / sahiplen — KRITIK (%%1540).

items.name: FILE_ALL_ACCESS
items.desc: Tam denetim (tum bitler). Tek basina = Full Control.

tr.note: O:owner G:group D:DACL S:SACL — her kod ACE icindeki KONUMUNA gore okunur

items.name: ACE Tipi
items.desc: Allow / Deny. Acik Deny her zaman Allow'u ezer.

items.name: Kalitim
items.desc: Container Inherit (alt klasorlere) / Object Inherit (alt dosyalara).

items.name: Audit Bayragi
items.desc: SACL'de: Success / Fail denetimi. (FA burada 'Failed', hak alaninda ise 'File All'!)

items.name: Dosya Hakki
items.desc: Hak alaninda: File All / File Read / File Write.

items.name: Iki Anlam
items.desc: Hak alaninda Write DAC; SID alaninda Everyone. Konuma bak!

items.name: Standart Hak
items.desc: Read Control / Delete / Write Owner.

items.name: SID Kisa
items.desc: Builtin Admins / Local System / Authenticated Users (WD=Everyone, CO=Creator Owner).

tr.note: Onkosul: bu olaylar loga dusmeli, yoksa 4663 hic gelmez

items.name: Politikayi Ac
items.desc: 'Audit File System' + 'Audit Detailed File Share' — Success VE Failure acik olmali.

items.name: Onkosul
items.desc: Denetlenecek klasore audit ACE (SACL) eklenmeli; yoksa erisim loglanmaz.

items.name: Filtrele
items.desc: @{LogName='Security'; Id=4663; StartTime=...} ile son erisimleri cek.

items.name: Ayristir
items.desc: 4663'te: [1]=Kullanici, [6]=DosyaYolu, [9]=ErisimTuru.

items.name: Avlanacak
items.desc: Izin/sahip degisimi (0x40000/0x80000) = yetki yukseltme / kaliciligin izi.

en.note: 4656 request → 4663 action → 4658 close (matched by the same Handle ID)

items.name: Share Connect
items.desc: Who, from which IP, connected over the network to which share (\\Server\Share).

items.name: File-Level Access
items.desc: Access check for a SINGLE file inside the share — more detailed than 5140.

items.name: Handle Requested
items.desc: The permission-check moment + the requested rights (Access Mask) appear here.

items.name: Object Accessed
items.desc: What the user ACTUALLY did on the file (read/write/delete). The core SOC event.

items.name: Handle Closed
items.desc: Links to 4656/4663 via the same Handle ID → the full life of one access.

items.name: Permissions Changed
items.desc: An object's DACL changed; old/new SDDL is logged = proof of WRITE_DAC use.

items.name: Audit Policy Changed
items.desc: Audit setting was changed. An attacker may be trying to blind logging.

en.note: Lines to map in SIEM / XML / .evtx output

items.name: Who
items.desc: SID + Account Name of the user performing the action.

items.name: Target
items.desc: Full disk path of the accessed file/folder (e.g. C:\Shares\Finance\report.xlsx).

items.name: Source
items.desc: IP of the connecting client (present in 5140/5145).

items.name: Correlator
items.desc: The key that links the 4656 / 4663 / 4658 events.

items.name: Request
items.desc: Requested rights; a hex value (4656).

items.name: Action
items.desc: The actual permission exercised; text or %%code (4663).

en.note: Watch out: 0x20/0x40/0x80 are often confused (standard rights are 0x20000+)

items.name: ReadData / List
items.desc: Read / list directory (%%4416).

items.name: WriteData / AddFile
items.desc: Write / add a new file (%%4417).

items.name: AppendData
items.desc: Append data to the end of a file.

items.name: Execute / Traverse
items.desc: Execute / enter a directory. (NOT READ_CONTROL — that is 0x20000.)

items.name: DeleteChild
items.desc: Delete a child file within a directory.

items.name: ReadAttributes
items.desc: Read a file's attributes.

items.name: DELETE
items.desc: Delete the file/folder (%%1537).

items.name: READ_CONTROL
items.desc: Read the object's permissions (ACL/DACL) (%%1538).

items.name: WRITE_DAC
items.desc: Change permissions — CRITICAL (%%1539). Hunt alongside 4670.

items.name: WRITE_OWNER
items.desc: Change owner / take ownership — CRITICAL (%%1540).

items.name: FILE_ALL_ACCESS
items.desc: Full control (all bits). On its own = Full Control.

en.note: O:owner G:group D:DACL S:SACL — each code is read by its POSITION in the ACE

items.name: ACE Type
items.desc: Allow / Deny. An explicit Deny always overrides Allow.

items.name: Inheritance
items.desc: Container Inherit (to subfolders) / Object Inherit (to child files).

items.name: Audit Flag
items.desc: In SACL: Success / Fail audit. (FA here = 'Failed'; in the rights field = 'File All'!)

items.name: File Right
items.desc: In the rights field: File All / File Read / File Write.

items.name: Two Meanings
items.desc: In the rights field = Write DAC; in the SID field = Everyone. Mind the position!

items.name: Standard Right
items.desc: Read Control / Delete / Write Owner.

items.name: SID Short
items.desc: Builtin Admins / Local System / Authenticated Users (WD=Everyone, CO=Creator Owner).

en.note: Precondition: these events must reach the log, or 4663 never appears

items.name: Enable Policy
items.desc: 'Audit File System' + 'Audit Detailed File Share' — both Success AND Failure on.

items.name: Precondition
items.desc: An audit ACE (SACL) must be set on the folder to audit; otherwise access is not logged.

items.name: Filter
items.desc: @{LogName='Security'; Id=4663; StartTime=...} to pull recent accesses.

items.name: Parse
items.desc: On 4663: [1]=User, [6]=FilePath, [9]=AccessType.

items.name: To Hunt
items.desc: Permission/owner change (0x40000/0x80000) = a trail of privilege escalation / persistence.
